_help: The cars to choose from. 'model' is a real car from the library (cars/<id>: web/cars/README.md lists them); 'length' is how long it is on the track, in metres (its width follows from the model). The rest are compared with the Sovereign: 'top' speed, 'accel' (how quickly it gets there), 'grip' (how fast it can take a turn before sliding) and 'weight' (who gets pushed around in a bump). 'traffic' lists the ordinary cars out on the streets (their 'top' is slow: they keep to the speed limit).

cars.name: Sovereign
cars.about: A big grand tourer. Quick everywhere, best at nothing.

cars.name: Goblin
cars.about: The wedge. Fastest of all on the long straights; a handful in the tight corners.

cars.name: Cheetah
cars.about: Low and light, all pick-up. Gone off the line.

cars.name: Abyss
cars.about: Long and planted. Turns in like it's on rails.

cars.name: Stinger
cars.about: Loud, angry and quick in a straight line. Brake early.

cars.name: Nomad
cars.about: A street racer with a wing. Grips hard, light in a bump.

cars.name: Kiri
cars.about: A nimble little coupé. Loves the tight streets downtown.

cars.name: Azura
cars.about: The hot hatch. Slow at the top end, but it never lets go.
